data.spiritual_significance: The name Azizahaat also holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is mention in Quran 21:84, where it refers to the wife of Pharaoh, Asiyah. Asiyah was a pious and righteous woman who believed in Allah and practiced her faith in secret while living in a hostile environment ruled by her non-believing husband. The name "Azizah" evokes her characteristic traits of being precious, gracious, and lovely, which serve as an inspiration for us to embody these qualities in our own lives. Additionally, it serves as a reminder of the power and value of Faith, reaffirming that spiritual growth and purity are an integral part of our identity.
